data.body:
[P2] Reject templates that leave telemetry requirements uncovered

Checking only file existence accepts a deployable template with missing `TestingMetadata` or a misspelled `telemetry-1` mapping. The runner exits successfully when no descriptions match the suite, before evaluating `--fail-on failed+uncovered` or writing reports. Artifact upload also ignores missing files, so this workflow can pass without validating any telemetry. Add a preflight comparison of telemetry requirement IDs against template mappings and explicit `NotImplemented` declarations, fail on missing required IDs, and cover the zero-match case with a regression test.
